baseline:
Take control of your health

Example Health helps you track symptoms, medications and appointments in one place, so you can share an accurate picture with your care team.

Features

– Log symptoms in seconds
– Set medication reminders that fit your routine
– Export a summary for your doctor

Example Health is not a substitute for professional medical advice.
